svg.title: The Window: Fumetti photo-comic
svg.desc: The Window (1D): a fumetti page of posed photo panels in grey photographic tone with typed captions, showing a guardhouse at three times of night. Down the right margin a typed guard rota gives each guard's rounds as bars on a clock; the player has laid his route's segments into the gap between two rounds, and the slack he found is boxed in amber.
svg.text: HE HAS NINE SECONDS BETWEEN THE HOUSE GOING DARK
AND THE SECOND ROUND. THE DOG IS NOT ON THE ROTA.
